summary: ING Groep filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its prior share buyback program (47,040,466 shares at avg €23.46, total €1.1B) and a new €1.0B buyback program. The new program runs from 30 Apr 2026 to no later than 26 Oct 2026, approved by the ECB and within existing 20% share authority. The purpose is to manage CET1 ratio around 13% (reported at 13.0% vs. 11.06% requirement). A non-discretionary arrangement with a financial intermediary will execute the buyback. Weekly updates will be provided.
